description: Verification by machine rather than by feel: writes and runs automated tests, reproduces bugs, reports what fails and how to trigger it. Covers regression before a release.
when_to_use: behaviour has to be proven correct, not just tried
a bug needs reproducing or a regression test
a release needs its test pass
avoid_when: the question is whether something is fun rather than correct
the request is to implement the fix
outputs: a pass or fail report with repro steps
